en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is not correct for the man that he sell by a Sa’a (a unit of measurement of four handfuls) of other than a Sa’a of the city’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not proper to sell with a Sa‘ (a certain measuring device) which is not in use in the city (land).’”
